blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala admitted that giving everything in a tennis match does not necessarily mean playing well, a difficult lesson driven home by criticism from her coach after a three-set contest. The Asian Games bronze medalist and world No. 18 in the Women’s Tennis Association singles rankings shared the experience during an October 7 appearance on Pretty Tough, the podcast hosted by her childhood tennis idol Maria Sharapova. READ: Alex Eala slowly becoming more versatile, complete player The rising Filipino star recalled a match shortly before the French Open, when she and her coach had sharply different assessments of her performance.
